summary: Grupo Simec, S.A.B. de C.V., a Mexican steel manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that it had submitted its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 to the SEC. The filing announces availability of the 20-F and audited financials on the company website, with hard copies available upon request from the finance coordinator. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, tender, or management change is described. The 6-K adds no new transaction details beyond the routine annual report filing disclosure. This filing is not a special situation and is classified as routine. What to watch: no event-driven catalysts are presented in this disclosure.
